data.description: Крафт-калькулятор для сервера YourWorld PVE. Все рецепты крафта, кейсов, оружия, медицины, электроники и консерв.
data.html:
<html lang="ru"><head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<link rel="icon" href="https://wiki-yourworld.ru/images/ywlogo.ico" sizes="any">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="https://wiki-yourworld.ru/images/ywlogo.png">
<title>Крафт-калькулятор YourWorld — Узнай что можно скрафтить</title>
<meta name="description" content="Крафт-калькулятор для сервера YourWorld PVE. Все рецепты крафта, кейсов, оружия, медицины, электроники и консерв.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#09090b">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<link rel="manifest" id="pwa-manifest" href="blob:https://rozegmor.github.io/578f3bca-3ea3-41d9-9e5d-2475713db353">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}

:root{--bg:#09090b;--bg2:#18181b;--bg3:#27272a;--border:#3f3f46;--text:#f4f4f5;--text2:#a1a1aa;--text3:#71717a;--accent:#f97316;--accent-hover:#ea580c;--green:#22c55e;--red:#ef4444;--radius:8px;--radius-sm:6px;--t:.4s ease}

html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden}

body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;transition:background-color .4s ease,color .4s ease}

.app{display:flex;height:100vh;overflow:hidden}

.left-panel{flex:1;padding:16px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden}

.right-panel{width:460px;flex-shrink:0;border-left:1px solid var(--bg3);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);position:relative;transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}

.right-content{flex:1;overflow:hidden}

.header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px;position:relative}.header-logo{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:6px;object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0}

.header-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;cursor:pointer}.header-title:hover{opacity:.85}

.header-title span{color:var(--accent)}

.header-badge{font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);background:var(--bg3);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap}

.search-wrap{flex:1;min-width:0}

.search-box{position:relative}

.search-box input{width:100%;padding:8px 12px 8px 34px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius);color:var(--text);font-size:13px;outline:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}.search-box input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(249,115,22,.12)}

.search-box svg{position:absolute;left:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--text3);pointer-events:none}

.categories{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin-bottom:10px;align-items:center}

.cat-btn{padding:4px 10px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:16px;color:var(--text2);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s,background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease,color .4s ease;white-space:nowrap;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}

.cat-count{color:var(--text3);font-size:10px;margin-left:1px}

.cat-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text)}

.cat-btn.active{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}

.cat-btn.active .cat-count{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}

.cat-btn.active .cat-hdd-badge{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}

.cat-hdd-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;font-size:9px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid;transition:background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}
.cat-hdd-badge.has{background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);color:var(--green);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.3)}
.cat-hdd-badge.missing{background:rgba(239,68,68,.1);color:var(--red);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.25)}
.cat-hdd-badge svg{width:9px;height:9px;flex-shrink:0}

.cat-divider{width:1px;height:18px;background:var(--bg3);margin:0 3px;flex-shrink:0;transition:background-color .4s ease}

.cat-label{font-size:9px;color:var(--text3);padding:0 4px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px;flex-shrink:0;transition:color .4s ease}

/* ===== GRID SECTION HEADERS (for Всё view) ===== */
.grid-section{margin-bottom:6px}
.grid-section-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:6px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s,background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease;user-select:none}
.grid-section-header:hover{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--bg3)}
.grid-section-header .gsh-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);flex:1}
.grid-section-header .gsh-cnt{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3)}
.grid-section-header .gsh-hdd{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid;transition:background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}
.grid-section-header .gsh-hdd.has{background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);color:var(--green);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.25)}
.grid-section-header .gsh-hdd.missing{background:rgba(239,68,68,.06);color:var(--red);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.2)}
.grid-section-header .gsh-hdd svg{width:12px;height:12px;flex-shrink:0}
.grid-section-header .gsh-toggle{color:var(--text3);font-size:11px;transition:transform .2s}
.grid-section-header .gsh-toggle.collapsed{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.grid-section-body{overflow:hidden}
.grid-section-body.collapsed{display:none}

.item-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:8px;padding-bottom:20px;overflow-y:auto;max-height:calc(100vh - 120px)}
#itemGrid:has(.grid-section){display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;max-height:calc(100vh - 120px);overflow-y:auto;padding-bottom:20px}
#itemGrid:has(.grid-section) .item-grid{max-height:none;overflow:visible;padding-bottom:8px}

.item-card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:10px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--bg3);background:var(--bg2);cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s,background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}

.item-card:hover{border-color:var(--border);background:var(--bg3)}

.item-card.selected{background:rgba(249,115,22,.08);border-color:rgba(249,115,22,.3)}

.item-card .ic-img{width:100%;height:96px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .15s}.item-card:hover .ic-img{transform:scale(1.03)}

.item-card .ic-img img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}

.item-card .ic-img .no-img{font-size:18px}

.item-card .ic-name{font-size:11px;text-align:center;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;min-height:2.2em}

.item-card .ic-cnt{font-size:10px;color:var(--text3)}

.item-card .ic-badge{position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;background:var(--accent);color:#000;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:99px}

.item-card .ic-btns{display:flex;gap:2px}

.item-card .ic-btns button{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;border:none;background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px}

.item-card .ic-btns button:hover{background:rgba(249,115,22,.2);color:var(--accent)}

.item-card .ic-btns button.minus:hover{background:rgba(239,68,68,.15);color:var(--red)}

/* right-tabs removed — now using stacked layout */

.right-content{flex:1;padding:16px;overflow-y:auto}

.empty-state{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;gap:8px;padding:20px}

.empty-state svg{width:48px;height:48px;opacity:.5}

.empty-state .title{font-size:14px;color:var(--text2)}

.empty-state .sub{font-size:12px}

.craft-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);margin-bottom:8px;transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}

.craft-item-img{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0}

.craft-item-img img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}

.craft-item-info{flex:1;min-width:0}

.craft-item-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

.craft-item-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0}

.craft-item-controls button{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--bg3);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;transition:all .15s}

.craft-item-controls button:hover{background:var(--bg3)}

.craft-item-controls span{width:28px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}

.section-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2);margin:16px 0 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}

.section-title:first-child{margin-top:0}

.section-title .line{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--bg3)}

.resource-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;margin-bottom:4px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,transform .1s;user-select:none}.resource-item:hover{filter:brightness(1.15);transform:translateX(2px)}.resource-item:active{transform:scale(.98)}

.resource-item.satisfied{background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);color:var(--green)}

.resource-item.missing{background:rgba(239,68,68,.08);color:var(--red)}

.resource-item .rname{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:break-word;line-height:1.4}

.resource-item .rqty{font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.resource-item .r-quick{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;margin-left:4px}
.resource-item .r-btn{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--bg3);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0}
.resource-item .r-btn:hover{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.resource-item .r-hint{font-size:9px;opacity:.6;margin-left:4px}
.resource-item.satisfied .r-hint{color:var(--green)}
.resource-item.missing .r-hint{color:var(--text3)}

.craftable-list{margin-top:4px}

.craftable-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(34,197,94,.06);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.15);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);margin-bottom:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}

.craftable-item:hover{background:rgba(34,197,94,.12)}

.craftable-item-img{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0}

.craftable-item-img img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}

.craftable-item-name{flex:1;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

.craftable-item-qty{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green);white-space:nowrap}
.craft-btn{padding:3px 10px;background:var(--green);border:none;border-radius:4px;color:#000;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s,transform .1s;flex-shrink:0}
.craft-btn:hover{background:#16a34a}
.craft-btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}

.not-craftable-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(239,68,68,.05);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.12);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);margin-bottom:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}

.not-craftable-item:hover{background:rgba(239,68,68,.1)}

.not-craftable-item-img{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0}

.not-craftable-item-img img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}

.not-craftable-item-name{flex:1;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

.not-craftable-item-qty{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);white-space:nowrap}

.inv-add{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}

.inv-add .autocomplete-wrap{flex:1;position:relative}

.inv-add input[type="text"],.inv-add input[type="number"]{padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);color:var(--text);font-size:13px;outline:none;transition:border-color .2s,background-color .4s ease,color .4s ease}

.inv-add input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}

.inv-add input[type="number"]{width:70px}

.inv-add button{padding:8px 14px;background:var(--accent);border:none;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s}

.inv-add button:hover{background:var(--accent-hover)}

.autocomplete-dropdown{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:0 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm);max-height:200px;overflow:hidden;z-index:100;transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}

.autocomplete-item{padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;transition:background .15s}

.autocomplete-item:hover,.autocomplete-item.active{background:var(--bg3)}

.inv-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;padding:8px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);margin-bottom:6px;transition:background-color .4s ease}

.inv-item .inv-name{flex:1;font-size:12px;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:break-word;line-height:1.4}

.inv-item .inv-qty-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}

.inv-item .inv-qty-wrap input[type="number"]{width:44px;padding:4px 2px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text);font-size:12px;text-align:center;outline:none;-moz-appearance:textfield}

.inv-item .inv-qty-wrap input[type="number"]::-webkit-inner-spin-button,.inv-item .inv-qty-wrap input[type="number"]::-webkit-outer-spin-button{display:none}

.inv-item .inv-qty-btn{width:22px;height:28px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--text2);font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}

.inv-item .inv-qty-btn:hover{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text)}

.inv-item .inv-del{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:4px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--red);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;opacity:.6;transition:opacity .2s}

.inv-item .inv-del:hover{opacity:1}

.threshold-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}

.threshold-row label{font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);white-space:nowrap}

.threshold-row input[type="range"]{display:none}.cs-slider{flex:1;position:relative;height:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;touch-action:none;user-select:none}.cs-track{width:100%;height:4px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:2px;position:relative}.cs-fill{height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:2px;position:absolute;top:0;left:0}.cs-thumb{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);cursor:grab;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px transparent;transition:box-shadow .15s}.cs-thumb:active{cursor:grabbing}

.threshold-row .val{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);min-width:36px;text-align:right}

/* ===== SUGGESTION SECTION (collapsible, prominent) ===== */
.suggestion-section{margin-bottom:16px;border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .4s ease}
.suggestion-section-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--bg2);cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:background .15s,border-color .4s ease,background-color .4s ease}
.suggestion-section-header:hover{background:var(--bg3)}
.ssh-icon{font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0}
.ssh-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);flex:1}
.ssh-badge{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap}
.ssh-badge-zero{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text3)}
.ssh-badge-partial{background:rgba(249,115,22,.15);color:var(--accent)}
.ssh-badge-ready{background:rgba(34,197,94,.15);color:var(--green)}
.ssh-toggle{font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);transition:transform .2s}
.suggestion-section-header.collapsed .ssh-toggle{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.suggestion-section-body{padding:12px 14px;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .25s ease,padding .25s ease,opacity .2s}
.suggestion-section-body.collapsed{max-height:0!important;padding:0 14px;opacity:0;overflow:hidden}

.suggestion-item{padding:10px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,background-color .4s ease}

.suggestion-item:hover{background:var(--bg3)}

.suggestion-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px}

.suggestion-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;flex:1;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

.suggestion-pct{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;min-width:40px;text-align:right}

.progress-bar{height:4px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:6px}

.progress-bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:2px;transition:width .3s}

.suggestion-ingredients{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px}

.suggestion-ing{font-size:11px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}

.suggestion-ing.ok{background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);color:var(--green)}

.suggestion-ing.no{background:rgba(239,68,68,.12);color:var(--red)}

.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);z-index:1000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s}

.modal-overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}

.modal{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:12px;max-width:500px;width:100%;max-height:80vh;overflow:hidden;transform:scale(.95);transition:transform .2s,background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}

.modal-overlay.open .modal{transform:scale(1)}

.modal-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg3);transition:border-color .4s ease}

.modal-header img{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);object-fit:contain}

.modal-header .info{flex:1;min-width:0}

.modal-header .name{font-size:16px;font-weight:600}

.modal-header .cat{font-size:12px;color:var(--text3)}

.modal-close{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:6px;border:none;background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;transition:background .15s}.modal-close:hover{background:var(--accent)}

.modal-body{padding:16px}

.modal-ingredients-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:10px}

.modal-ingredient{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg3);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;border-radius:4px;margin:0 -4px}.modal-ingredient:hover{background:rgba(249,115,22,.06)}

.modal-ingredient:last-child{border-bottom:none}

.modal-ingredient .ing-name{flex:1}

.modal-ingredient .ing-qty{color:var(--text2);white-space:nowrap}
.modal-ingredient .ing-hint{font-size:9px;color:var(--text3);opacity:.7;white-space:nowrap}

.modal-ingredient .ing-status{width:20px;text-align:center}

.modal-craft-btn{margin-top:0;width:100%;padding:10px;background:var(--accent);border:none;border-radius:var(--radius);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:background .2s}

.modal-craft-btn:hover{background:var(--accent-hover)}
.modal-craft-btn[style*="green"]:hover{background:#16a34a!important}

.inv-modal-btn{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--bg3);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;transition:all .2s;flex-shrink:0;position:relative}
.inv-modal-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
.inv-modal-btn .inv-count{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;background:var(--accent);color:#000;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;min-width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:99px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 3px;pointer-events:none;animation:eggPop .2s ease}
.inv-modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;display:flex;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s}
.inv-modal-overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:none}

.welcome-hint .wh-close{float:right;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text3);font-size:14px;line-height:1;padding:0 2px;transition:color .15s}
.welcome-hint .wh-close:hover{color:var(--red)}
.hdd-inv-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:8px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);margin-bottom:6px;border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.15);transition:background .3s,border-color .3s;cursor:pointer}
.hdd-inv-item:hover{opacity:.85}
.hdd-inv-item.has{border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.3);background:rgba(34,197,94,.04)}
.hdd-inv-item-name{flex:1;font-size:12px;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:break-word;line-height:1.4}
.hdd-inv-item-status{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.hdd-inv-item-status.has{color:var(--green)}
.hdd-inv-item-status.missing{color:var(--red)}
.save-toast{position:fixed;bottom:60px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--green);color:var(--green);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;z-index:2001;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s,background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease,color .4s ease;pointer-events:none}
.save-toast.show{opacity:1}

/* ===== PROTECTION ===== */
body{-webkit-user-select:none;-moz-user-select:none;-ms-user-select:none;user-select:none}
input,textarea,[contenteditable="true"]{-webkit-user-select:text;-moz-user-select:text;-ms-user-select:text;user-select:text}
img{-webkit-user-drag:none;-khtml-user-drag:none;-moz-user-drag:none;-o-user-drag:none;user-drag:none;pointer-events:none}
._dt-blur{filter:blur(12px)!important;pointer-events:none!important;transition:filter .3s}

/* ===== HDD ===== */
.hdd-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap;margin-left:4px;transition:background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}
.hdd-tag.requires{background:rgba(59,130,246,.12);color:#60a5fa;border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.25)}
.hdd-tag.has{background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);color:var(--green);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.3)}
.hdd-tag.missing{background:rgba(239,68,68,.1);color:var(--red);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25)}
.hdd-tag.base{background:rgba(34,197,94,.1);color:var(--green);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.2)}
.hdd-tag svg{width:10px;height:10px;flex-shrink:0}
.modal-hdd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;padding:6px 10px;background:rgba(59,130,246,.08);border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.2);border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;color:#60a5fa;transition:background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}
.modal-hdd.has{background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.25);color:var(--green)}
.modal-hdd.missing{background:rgba(239,68,68,.06);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.2);color:var(--red)}
.modal-hdd svg{width:14px;height:14px;flex-shrink:0}
.modal-hdd.base-hdd{background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.2);color:var(--green)}
/* old cat-hdd/cat-sep/cat-group-label removed - replaced by cat-hdd-badge/cat-divider/cat-label */
.ct-hdd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:4px 8px;margin-bottom:6px;background:rgba(59,130,246,.08);border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.15);border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;color:#60a5fa;transition:background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}
.ct-hdd.has{background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.2);color:var(--green)}
.ct-hdd.missing{background:rgba(239,68,68,.06);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.15);color:var(--red)}
.ct-hdd svg{width:12px;height:12px;flex-shrink:0}

/* ===== CRAFT PROGRESS BAR ===== */
.craft-progress{width:100%;height:6px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:4px}
.craft-progress-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s}
.craft-progress-fill.full{background:var(--green)}
.craft-progress-fill.partial{background:#eab308}
.craft-progress-fill.low{background:var(--red)}
.craft-pct{font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px;text-align:right}

/* ===== CRAFT HISTORY ===== */
.history-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:2px 8px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text2);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap}
.history-btn:hover{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.history-btn svg{width:12px;height:12px;flex-shrink:0}
.history-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);margin-bottom:4px;font-size:12px}
.history-item .hi-name{flex:1;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;color:var(--text2)}
.history-item .hi-qty{color:var(--green);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.history-item .hi-time{color:var(--text3);font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap}
.history-undo{padding:2px 8px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text2);font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap}
.history-undo:hover{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}

/* ===== RECENT RECIPES ===== */
.recent-bar{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px;overflow-x:auto;padding:6px 8px;scrollbar-width:none;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius);min-height:40px;align-items:center}
.recent-bar::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none!important;width:0!important;height:0!important}
.recent-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 12px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:20px;color:var(--text2);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
.recent-chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text);background:var(--bg3)}
.recent-chip img{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:4px;object-fit:contain}

/* ===== DRAG QUEUE ===== */
.craft-item[draggable="true"]{cursor:grab}
.craft-item.dragging{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.97)}
.craft-item.drag-over{border-top:2px solid var(--accent)}

/* ===== SOURCE TOOLTIP ===== */
.source-tip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(139,92,246,.1);color:#a78bfa;border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.2);margin-left:4px;cursor:help;position:relative}
.source-tip:hover .source-tip-popup{display:block}
.source-tip-popup{display:none;position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 6px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bg3);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);white-space:nowrap;z-index:100;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}

/* ===== THEME TOGGLE ===== */
.theme-toggle{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--bg3);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;transition:all .2s,background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease;flex-shrink:0}
.theme-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}

/* ===== LIGHT THEME ===== */
html.light{--bg:#d4d5d8;--bg2:#dfdde0;--bg3:#c4c2c6;--border:#a8a6ab;--text:#1c1c22;--text2:#3d3d45;--text3:#63636c;--accent:#e06510;--accent-hover:#c85a0e;--green:#15803d;--red:#b91c1c}
html.light .item-card{box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.1);transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease,box-shadow .4s ease}
html.light .grid-section-header{box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
html.light .craft-item{box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08);transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}
html.light .modal{box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
html.light .search-box input{background:var(--bg2);border-color:var(--bg3);transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}
html.light .search-box input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(224,101,16,.15)}
html.light .right-panel{transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}
html.light .cat-btn{transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease,color .4s ease}
html.light .inv-item{transition:background-color .4s ease}
html.light .suggestion-item{transition:background-color .4s ease}
html.light .suggestion-section{transition:border-color .4s ease}
html.light .suggestion-section-header{transition:background .15s,border-color .4s ease,background-color .4s ease}
html.light .autocomplete-dropdown{transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}
html.light .changelog-modal{transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}
html.light .modal-header{transition:border-color .4s ease}
html.light .section-title .line{transition:background-color .4s ease}
html.light .share-btn{transition:all .15s,background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease,color .4s ease}
html.light .changelog-header{transition:border-color .4s ease}
html.light .footer-info{transition:border-color .4s ease,color .4s ease}
html.light .craft-item-controls button{transition:all .15s,background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}
html.light .inv-qty-wrap{transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}
html.light .inv-modal{transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}

html.light .bottom-nav{transition:background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}
html.light *{scrollbar-color:transparent transparent}
</style>
</head>

// ===== RESOURCE CALCULATIONS =====
function getInvMap(){const m={};state.inventory.forEach(i=>{m[i.name]=(m[i.name]||0)+i.qty});return m}
function getHddMap(){const m={};state.hddInventory.forEach(name=>{m[name]=1});return m}
function hasHdd(category){const hddName=HARDDRIVES[category];if(!hddName)return true;return state.hddInventory.includes(hddName)}
function getHddStatusClass(category){if(!HARDDRIVES[category])return'base';return hasHdd(category)?'has':'missing'}

function getAggregatedResources(){
const m={};
state.craftItems.forEach(ci=>{const r=RECIPES.find(x=>x.name===ci.name);if(!r)return;
r.ingredients.forEach(ing=>{m[ing.name]=(m[ing.name]||0)+ing.quantity*ci.qty})});return m}

function calcSuggestion(recipe,invMap){
const unique=new Map();
recipe.ingredients.forEach(i=>{unique.set(i.name,(unique.get(i.name)||0)+i.quantity)});
let satisfied=0;unique.forEach((qty,name)=>{if((invMap[name]||0)>=qty)satisfied++});
return{total:unique.size,satisfied,pct:unique.size?Math.round(satisfied/unique.size*100):0};
}

let acIndex=-1;
// ===== CRAFT LIST SHARING =====
function generateCraftText(){
const invMap=getInvMap();
const agg=getAggregatedResources();
const missing=Object.entries(agg).filter(([name,needed])=>(invMap[name]||0)<needed).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
if(!missing.length)return'Всё есть — крафть!\n\nКрафт-калькулятор YourWorld — rozegmor.github.io/yourworld-craft-calc';
const list=missing.map(([name,needed])=>{const have=invMap[name]||0;return name+' x'+(needed-have)}).join('\n');
return'Не хватает:\n'+list+'\n\nКрафт-калькулятор YourWorld — rozegmor.github.io/yourworld-craft-calc';
}
function showToast(msg){
const t=document.getElementById('toast');if(!t)return;
t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');
clearTimeout(t._timer);
t._timer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2000);
}
function copyCraftList(){
const text=generateCraftText();
navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(()=>showToast('Скопировано в буфер!')).catch(()=>{
const ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=text;document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();document.execCommand('copy');document.body.removeChild(ta);showToast('Скопировано в буфер!');
});
}
function downloadCraftList(){
const text=generateCraftText();
const blob=new Blob([text],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'});
const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='craft-list.txt';a.click();
URL.revokeObjectURL(url);showToast('Файл скачан!');
}

function addCraftItem(name){const ex=state.craftItems.find(x=>x.name===name);if(ex)ex.qty++;else state.craftItems.push({name,qty:1});saveState();render()}
function rmCraftItem(name){const ex=state.craftItems.find(x=>x.name===name);if(ex){if(ex.qty>1)ex.qty--;else state.craftItems=state.craftItems.filter(x=>x.name!==name)}saveState();render()}

function doCraft(name){
const r=RECIPES.find(x=>x.name===name);if(!r)return;
const ci=state.craftItems.find(x=>x.name===name);if(!ci)return;
const invMap=getInvMap();
const hddNames=new Set(Object.values(HARDDRIVES));
let maxCraftable=ci.qty;
r.ingredients.forEach(ing=>{if(hddNames.has(ing.name))return;const have=invMap[ing.name]||0;const canMake=Math.floor(have/ing.quantity);if(canMake<maxCraftable)maxCraftable=canMake});
if(maxCraftable<=0){showToast('Не хватает ресурсов для крафта!');return}
const craftQty=Math.min(maxCraftable,ci.qty);
const usedResources=[];
r.ingredients.forEach(ing=>{
if(hddNames.has(ing.name))return;
const invItem=state.inventory.find(x=>x.name===ing.name);
if(invItem){usedResources.push({name:ing.name,qty:ing.quantity*craftQty,before:invItem.qty});invItem.qty-=ing.quantity*craftQty;if(invItem.qty<=0)state.inventory=state.inventory.filter(x=>x.qty>0)}
});
ci.qty-=craftQty;
if(ci.qty<=0)state.craftItems=state.craftItems.filter(x=>x.qty>0);
state.craftHistory.unshift({name,qty:craftQty,resources:usedResources,time:Date.now()});
if(state.craftHistory.length>50)state.craftHistory.length=50;
saveState();render();
showToast('Скрафтено: '+name+' x'+craftQty);
if(!state.stats)state.stats={totalCrafts:0,recipesViewed:0,sessionStart:Date.now()};
state.stats.totalCrafts=(state.stats.totalCrafts||0)+craftQty;
saveState();
spawnConfetti();
}

function renderCraftTab(){
const el=document.getElementById("rightContent");
const showWelcome=!state.inventory.length&&!state.craftItems.length&&!localStorage.getItem('yw_welcome_dismissed');
if(!state.craftItems.length){
let welcomeHtml='';
if(showWelcome){
welcomeHtml=`<div class="welcome-hint" id="welcomeHint"><span class="wh-close" id="welcomeClose">×</span><div class="wh-title">Как пользоваться калькулятором</div><div class="wh-step"><span class="wh-num">1</span><span>Нажмите 🎒 вверху → добавьте ресурсы которые у вас есть в игре</span></div><div class="wh-step"><span class="wh-num">2</span><span>Нажмите <b>+</b> на карточке предмета, чтобы добавить его в список крафта</span></div><div class="wh-step"><span class="wh-num">3</span><span>Секция <b>Что собрать</b> покажет что вы можете скрафтить из ваших ресурсов</span></div><div class="wh-step"><span class="wh-num">4</span><span>Если для рецепта нужен жёсткий диск — отметьте его в инвентаре (🎒 → Диски)</span></div></div>`;
}
el.innerHTML=`${welcomeHtml}<div class="empty-state">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M16.5 9.4l-9-5.19M21 16V8a2 2 0 00-1-1.73l-7-4a2 2 0 00-2 0l-7 4A2 2 0 003 8v8a2 2 0 001 1.73l7 4a2 2 0 002 0l7-4A2 2 0 0021 16z"/><polyline points="3.27 6.96 12 12.01 20.73 6.96"/><line x1="12" y1="22.08" x2="12" y2="12"/></svg>
<div class="title">Список крафта пуст</div>
<div class="sub">Нажмите + на карточке предмета слева, чтобы добавить его сюда</div>
</div>`;if(window._initCSB)window._initCSB(el);
const wc=document.getElementById("welcomeClose");if(wc)wc.addEventListener("click",()=>{localStorage.setItem('yw_welcome_dismissed','1');const h=document.getElementById("welcomeHint");if(h)h.style.display='none'});
return;
}
const invMap=getInvMap();
const agg=getAggregatedResources();
let html=`<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px"><span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3)">${state.craftItems.length} в списке</span><div class="share-btns"><button class="share-btn" id="copyCraftBtn" title="Скопировать список крафта"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"/><path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 01-2-2V4a2 2 0 012-2h9a2 2 0 012 2v1"/></svg>Скопировать</button><button class="share-btn" id="downloadCraftBtn" title="Скачать список крафта как файл"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg>Скачать</button><button id="clearCraftBtn" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--red);background:none;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.3);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 8px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s">Очистить</button></div></div>`;
state.craftItems.forEach((ci,idx)=>{
const r=RECIPES.find(x=>x.name===ci.name);
if(!r)return;
const img=r.image?`<img src="${r.image}" alt="">`:'';
const escName=r.name.replace(/"/g,""");
const invMap2=getInvMap();
const uniqueMap=new Map();r.ingredients.forEach(i=>{uniqueMap.set(i.name,(uniqueMap.get(i.name)||0)+i.quantity*ci.qty)});
let haveAll=0,totalAll=0;uniqueMap.forEach((qty,name)=>{const have=invMap2[name]||0;haveAll+=Math.min(have,qty);totalAll+=qty});
const pct=totalAll?Math.round(haveAll/totalAll*100):0;
const pctClass=pct>=100?"full":pct>=50?"partial":"low";
html+=`<div class="craft-item" draggable="true" data-craft-idx="${idx}">
<div class="craft-item-img">${img}</div>
<div class="craft-item-info"><div class="craft-item-name" title="${escName}">${r.name}</div>
<div class="craft-progress" title="Насколько хватает ресурсов: ${pct}%"><div class="craft-progress-fill ${pctClass}" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div>
<div class="craft-pct">${pct}% есть</div>
</div>
<div class="craft-item-controls">
<button data-craft-minus="${idx}">\u2212</button>
<span>${ci.qty}</span>
<button data-craft-plus="${idx}">+</button>
<button data-craft-remove="${idx}" style="color:var(--red);margin-left:4px">\u2715</button>
</div></div>`;
});
const resEntries=Object.entries(agg).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
if(resEntries.length){
html+=`<div class="section-title">Нужные ресурсы (${resEntries.length}) <span class="line"></span></div>`;
html+=`<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:8px">Кликните по ресурсу чтобы добавить в инвентарь, или используйте +/-</div>`;
resEntries.forEach(([name,needed])=>{
const have=invMap[name]||0;
const ok=have>=needed;
const src=RESOURCE_SOURCES[name]||'';
const srcTag=src?`<span class="source-tip">\u2139<span class="source-tip-popup">Где взять: ${src}</span></span>`:'';
const hddNames=new Set(Object.values(HARDDRIVES));const isHdd=hddNames.has(name);
html+=`<div class="resource-item ${ok?"satisfied":"missing"}" data-res-name="${name.replace(/"/g,""")}" data-res-need="${needed}" data-res-have="${have}">
<span>${ok?"\u2705":"\u274c"}</span>
<span class="rname">${name}${srcTag}</span>
<span class="rqty">${have}/${needed}</span>
<span class="r-quick">
<button class="r-btn" data-res-minus="${name.replace(/"/g,""")}" title="Убрать 1">\u2212</button>
<button class="r-btn" data-res-plus="${name.replace(/"/g,""")}" title="Добавить 1">+</button>
</span>
${!ok&&needed>0?`<span class="r-hint">нужно ещё ${needed-have}</span>`:''}
${ok?`<span class="r-hint">в инвентаре</span>`:''}
</div>`;
});
}
const canCraftList=[];
const cantCraftList=[];
state.craftItems.forEach(ci=>{
const r=RECIPES.find(x=>x.name===ci.name);if(!r)return;
let maxCraftable=ci.qty;
r.ingredients.forEach(ing=>{
const have=invMap[ing.name]||0;
const canMake=Math.floor(have/ing.quantity);
if(canMake<maxCraftable)maxCraftable=canMake;
});
if(maxCraftable>0)canCraftList.push({recipe:r,qty:maxCraftable});
if(maxCraftable<ci.qty)cantCraftList.push({recipe:r,qty:ci.qty-maxCraftable});
});
if(canCraftList.length){
html+=`<div class="section-title" style="color:var(--green)">Можно скрафтить сейчас <span class="line"></span></div><div class="craftable-list">`;
canCraftList.forEach(({recipe:r,qty})=>{
const img=r.image?`<img src="${r.image}" alt="">`:'';
html+=`<div class="craftable-item" data-craftable-name="${r.name.replace(/"/g,""")}">
<div class="craftable-item-img">${img}</div>
<div class="craftable-item-name" title="${r.name.replace(/"/g,""")}">${r.name}</div>
<div class="craftable-item-qty">x${qty}</div>
<button class="craft-btn" data-craft-do="${r.name.replace(/"/g,""")}">Скрафтить</button>
</div>`;
});
html+=`</div>`;
}
if(cantCraftList.length){
const remainingInv={...invMap};
canCraftList.forEach(({recipe:r,qty})=>{r.ingredients.forEach(ing=>{remainingInv[ing.name]=(remainingInv[ing.name]||0)-ing.quantity*qty})});
html+=`<div class="section-title" style="color:var(--red)">Не хватает ресурсов для <span class="line"></span></div><div class="craftable-list">`;
cantCraftList.forEach(({recipe:r,qty})=>{
const img=r.image?`<img src="${r.image}" alt="">`:'';
const info=calcSuggestion(r,remainingInv);
html+=`<div class="not-craftable-item" data-craftable-name="${r.name.replace(/"/g,""")}">
<div class="not-craftable-item-img">${img}</div>
<div class="not-craftable-item-name" title="${r.name.replace(/"/g,""")}">${r.name}</div>
<div class="not-craftable-item-qty">${info.pct}%</div>
</div>`;
});
html+=`</div>`;
}
el.innerHTML=html;if(window._initCSB)window._initCSB(el);
}

function setupAutocomplete(searchId,acId){

const v=inp.value.toLowerCase().replace(/ё/g,'е');

const matches=ALL_RESOURCES.filter(r=>{const n=r.toLowerCase().replace(/ё/g,'е');if(n.indexOf(v)===0)return true;const words=n.split(/\s+/);for(let i=1;i<words.length;i++){if(words[i].indexOf(v)===0)return true;}return false;});
matches.sort((a,b)=>{const na=a.toLowerCase().replace(/ё/g,'е'),nb=b.toLowerCase().replace(/ё/g,'е');const aS=na.indexOf(v)===0?0:1;const bS=nb.indexOf(v)===0?0:1;if(aS!==bS)return aS-bS;return na.localeCompare(nb,'ru');});

});

// ===== CUSTOM SLIDER =====
// Custom slider — query live DOM elements on each move
(function(){
function init(el){
if(!el||el._csInit)return;el._csInit=true;
var min=+el.dataset.min||0,max=+el.dataset.max||100,step=+el.dataset.step||1,val=+el.dataset.value||0;
function update(){
var cs=document.getElementById('csSlider');if(!cs)return;
var pct=((val-min)/(max-min))*100;
cs.querySelector('.cs-fill').style.width=pct+'%';
cs.querySelector('.cs-thumb').style.left=pct+'%';
cs.dataset.value=val;
}
el.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){
e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
var savedWidth=el.offsetWidth,savedLeft=el.getBoundingClientRect().left;
var ov=document.createElement('div');
ov.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:99999;touch-action:none;user-select:none;cursor:grabbing;';
document.body.appendChild(ov);
var curVal=val;
function setThumb(pct){
var cs=document.getElementById('csSlider');if(!cs)return;
cs.querySelector('.cs-fill').style.width=pct+'%';
cs.querySelector('.cs-thumb').style.left=pct+'%';
}
function calc(cx){
var ratio=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(cx-savedLeft)/savedWidth));
return Math.max(min,Math.min(max,Math.round((min+ratio*(max-min))/step)*step));
}
function calcPct(cx){return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(cx-savedLeft)/savedWidth))*100}
setThumb(calcPct(e.clientX));
var nv=calc(e.clientX);
if(nv!==curVal){curVal=nv;var tv=document.getElementById('threshVal');if(tv)tv.textContent=nv+'%'}
function onMove(ev){
ev.preventDefault();
setThumb(calcPct(ev.clientX));
var nv=calc(ev.clientX);
if(nv!==curVal){curVal=nv;var tv=document.getElementById('threshVal');if(tv)tv.textContent=nv+'%'}
}
function onUp(){
ov.removeEventListener('mousemove',onMove);ov.removeEventListener('mouseup',onUp);ov.remove();
val=curVal;
var cs=document.getElementById('csSlider');
if(cs){
var pct=((val-min)/(max-min))*100;
cs.querySelector('.cs-fill').style.width=pct+'%';
cs.querySelector('.cs-thumb').style.left=pct+'%';
cs.dataset.value=val;
}
state.suggestionThreshold=val;
var tv=document.getElementById('threshVal');
if(tv)tv.textContent=val+'%';
saveState();
renderAllInOne();
}
ov.addEventListener('mousemove',onMove);
ov.addEventListener('mouseup',onUp);
});
update();
}
var obs=new MutationObserver(function(){init(document.getElementById('csSlider'))});
obs.observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
init(document.getElementById('csSlider'));
})();

// Custom Scrollbar System
(function(){
function initCustomScrollbar(el){
if(!el)return;
// Cleanup old listeners/observers from previous init
if(el._csCleanup){el._csCleanup();el._csCleanup=null}
var oldSb=el.querySelector('.cs-sb-v');if(oldSb)oldSb.remove();el._cSbInit=true;el.classList.add('cs-scroller');
var sb=document.createElement('div');sb.className='cs-sb-v';
sb.innerHTML='<div class="cs-sb-track"><div class="cs-sb-thumb"></div></div>';
el.appendChild(sb);var thumb=sb.querySelector('.cs-sb-thumb'),track=sb.querySelector('.cs-sb-track'),hideTimer=null,isDragging=false;
function showSb(){el.classList.add('cs-scrolling');clearTimeout(hideTimer);hideTimer=setTimeout(function(){if(!isDragging)el.classList.remove('cs-scrolling')},1200)}
function updateThumb(){
var ch=el.clientHeight,sh=el.scrollHeight,st=el.scrollTop;
if(sh<=ch+1){sb.style.display='none';return}
sb.style.display='';
sb.style.top=st+'px';
sb.style.height=ch+'px';
var thumbH=Math.max(30,Math.round((ch/sh)*ch));
thumb.style.height=thumbH+'px';
var maxTop=ch-thumbH;
var ratio=st>0?st/(sh-ch):0;
thumb.style.top=(ratio*maxTop)+'px';
}
function onWheel(e){
if(el.scrollHeight<=el.clientHeight+1)return;
var d=e.deltaY;
if(Math.abs(d)<2)d=e.deltaX;
var newST=Math.max(0,Math.min(el.scrollHeight-el.clientHeight,el.scrollTop+d));
if(newST!==el.scrollTop){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();el.scrollTop=newST;updateThumb();showSb()}
}
el.addEventListener('wheel',onWheel,{passive:false});
var docCleanup=null;
thumb.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){
e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();thumb.classList.add('cs-active');isDragging=true;
var startY=e.clientY,startST=el.scrollTop;
var savedCh=el.clientHeight,savedSh=el.scrollHeight,savedThumbH=thumb.offsetHeight;
function onMove(ev){
ev.preventDefault();
var dy=ev.clientY-startY;
var trackH=savedCh-savedThumbH;
if(trackH<=0)return;
var newST=startST+(dy/trackH)*(savedSh-savedCh);
el.scrollTop=Math.max(0,Math.min(savedSh-savedCh,newST));
updateThumb();showSb();
}
function onUp(){isDragging=false;thumb.classList.remove('cs-active');document.removeEventListener('mousemove',onMove);document.removeEventListener('mouseup',onUp);docCleanup=null;
clearTimeout(hideTimer);hideTimer=setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('cs-scrolling')},800)}
if(docCleanup)docCleanup();
document.addEventListener('mousemove',onMove);document.addEventListener('mouseup',onUp);
docCleanup=function(){document.removeEventListener('mousemove',onMove);document.removeEventListener('mouseup',onUp)};
});
track.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){
if(e.target===thumb)return;e.preventDefault();
var rect=sb.getBoundingClientRect(),clickY=e.clientY-rect.top,ch=el.clientHeight,sh=el.scrollHeight;
el.scrollTop=Math.max(0,Math.min(sh-ch,(clickY/ch)*sh-ch/2));
updateThumb();showSb();
});
var resizeObs=new ResizeObserver(function(){updateThumb()});resizeObs.observe(el);
var mutObs=new MutationObserver(function(){updateThumb()});mutObs.observe(el,{childList:true,subtree:true,attributes:false,characterData:false});
el._csSbUpdate=updateThumb;
el._csCleanup=function(){
el.removeEventListener('wheel',onWheel);
if(docCleanup)docCleanup();
resizeObs.disconnect();
mutObs.disconnect();
};
setTimeout(updateThumb,0);
}

function renderStats(){

const historyCount=state.craftHistory.length;
const favCount=getFavs().length;
const uniqueCrafted=new Set(state.craftHistory.map(h=>h.name)).size;

const allIngredients=new Set();
RECIPES.forEach(r=>r.ingredients.forEach(i=>allIngredients.add(i.name)));
const invCoverage=Math.round((totalInv/Math.max(allIngredients.size,1))*100);

const completionRatio=Math.round((uniqueCrafted/Math.max(RECIPES.length,1))*100);

let html=`
<div class="stats-grid">
<div class="stats-card"><div class="stats-card-value">${st.totalCrafts}</div><div class="stats-card-label">Всего крафтов</div></div>

<div class="stats-card"><div class="stats-card-value">${favCount}</div><div class="stats-card-label">В избранном</div></div>
<div class="stats-card green"><div class="stats-card-value">${craftList}</div><div class="stats-card-label">В очереди на крафт</div></div>
</div>`;

html+=`<div class="stats-section-title">Покрытие инвентаря</div>`;
html+=`<div class="stats-bar"><span class="stats-bar-label">Ресурсы</span><div class="stats-bar-track"><div class="stats-bar-fill green" style="width:${invCoverage}%"></div></div><span class="stats-bar-val">${invCoverage}%</span></div>`;
html+=`<div class="stats-bar"><span class="stats-bar-label">Рецепты</span><div class="stats-bar-track"><div class="stats-bar-fill orange" style="width:${completionRatio}%"></div></div><span class="stats-bar-val">${completionRatio}%</span></div>`;

Object.entries(categoryCrafts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,5).forEach(([cat,cnt])=>{

if(totalResQty>0){

function buildCraftTree(recipe,mult,visited){
if(!mult)mult=1;if(!visited)visited=new Set();
const invMap=getInvMap();
let html='<div class="craft-tree">';
// HDD requirement at top
const hddName=HARDDRIVES[recipe.category];
if(hddName){
const haveHdd=hasHdd(recipe.category);
const sc=getHddStatusClass(recipe.category);
html+='<div class="ct-hdd '+sc+'"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="12" rx="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/><path d="M6 12h.01M18 12h.01"/></svg><span>Нужен диск: '+hddName+'</span><span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;color:'+(haveHdd?"var(--green)":"var(--red)")+'">'+(haveHdd?"\u2705 есть":"\u274c нет")+'</span></div>';
}
const subRecipes=recipe.ingredients.filter(ing=>RECIPES.some(r=>r.name===ing.name));
const baseIngr=recipe.ingredients.filter(ing=>!RECIPES.some(r=>r.name===ing.name));
if(subRecipes.length){
html+='<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:4px">Нужно скрафтить сначала:</div>';
subRecipes.forEach(ing=>{
const subR=RECIPES.find(r=>r.name===ing.name);
const needQty=ing.quantity*mult;
const haveQty=invMap[ing.name]||0;
const ok=haveQty>=needQty;
const isCircular=visited.has(ing.name);
html+='<div class="ct-node"><div class="ct-item">';
if(subR&&!isCircular)html+='<span class="ct-toggle" data-ct-toggle="'+ing.name.replace(/"/g,""")+'">▶</span>';
else html+='<span class="ct-toggle" style="visibility:hidden">▶</span>';
html+='<span class="ct-name'+(isCircular?" ct-base":"")+'">'+ing.name+'</span>';
html+='<span class="ct-qty">x'+needQty+'</span>';
html+='<span class="ct-have '+(ok?"ok":"no")+'">'+haveQty+'/'+needQty+'</span>';
html+='</div>';
if(subR&&!isCircular){
visited.add(ing.name);
html+='<div class="ct-children" data-ct-children="'+ing.name.replace(/"/g,""")+'" style="display:none">';
html+=buildTreeInner(subR,needQty,visited);

visited.delete(ing.name);
}
html+='</div>';
});
}
if(baseIngr.length){
html+='<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin:6px 0 4px">Базовые ресурсы:</div>';
baseIngr.forEach(ing=>{
const needQty=ing.quantity*mult;
const haveQty=invMap[ing.name]||0;
const ok=haveQty>=needQty;
html+='<div class="ct-node"><div class="ct-item">';

html+='<span class="ct-have '+(ok?"ok":"no")+'">'+haveQty+'/'+needQty+'</span>';
html+='</div></div>';
});
}
html+='</div>';
return html;
}
function buildTreeInner(recipe,mult,visited){
const invMap=getInvMap();
let html='';
const subRecipes=recipe.ingredients.filter(ing=>RECIPES.some(r=>r.name===ing.name));
const baseIngr=recipe.ingredients.filter(ing=>!RECIPES.some(r=>r.name===ing.name));
subRecipes.forEach(ing=>{
const subR=RECIPES.find(r=>r.name===ing.name);
const needQty=ing.quantity*mult;
const haveQty=invMap[ing.name]||0;
const ok=haveQty>=needQty;
const isCircular=visited.has(ing.name);
html+='<div class="ct-node"><div class="ct-item">';
if(subR&&!isCircular)html+='<span class="ct-toggle" data-ct-toggle="'+ing.name.replace(/"/g,""")+'">▶</span>';
else html+='<span class="ct-toggle" style="visibility:hidden">▶</span>';
html+='<span class="ct-name'+(isCircular?" ct-base":"")+'">'+ing.name+'</span>';
html+='<span class="ct-qty">x'+needQty+'</span>';
html+='<span class="ct-have '+(ok?"ok":"no")+'">'+haveQty+'/'+needQty+'</span>';
html+='</div>';
if(subR&&!isCircular){
visited.add(ing.name);
html+='<div class="ct-children" data-ct-children="'+ing.name.replace(/"/g,""")+'" style="display:none">';
html+=buildTreeInner(subR,needQty,visited);
html+='</div>';
visited.delete(ing.name);
}
html+='</div>';
});
baseIngr.forEach(ing=>{
const needQty=ing.quantity*mult;
const haveQty=invMap[ing.name]||0;
const ok=haveQty>=needQty;
html+='<div class="ct-node"><div class="ct-item">';
html+='<span class="ct-toggle" style="visibility:hidden">▶</span>';
html+='<span class="ct-name ct-base">'+ing.name+'</span>';
html+='<span class="ct-qty">x'+needQty+'</span>';
html+='<span class="ct-have '+(ok?"ok":"no")+'">'+haveQty+'/'+needQty+'</span>';
html+='</div></div>';
});
return html;
}

// Toggle craft tree nodes
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{
if(e.target.matches(".ct-toggle")){
const name=e.target.dataset.ctToggle;

children.style.display=isOpen?"none":"block";

}
}
});

// ===== FEATURE: MULTI-CRAFT =====
function calcMultiCraft(recipe,count){
const result={};
function recurse(r,mult,visited){
if(!visited)visited=new Set();
r.ingredients.forEach(ing=>{
const subR=RECIPES.find(x=>x.name===ing.name);
if(subR&&!visited.has(ing.name)){
visited.add(ing.name);
recurse(subR,ing.quantity*mult,new Set(visited));
} else {
result[ing.name]=(result[ing.name]||0)+ing.quantity*mult;
}
});
}
recurse(recipe,count,new Set());
return result;
}

_origSaveState();
};

const data={inventory:state.inventory,hddInventory:state.hddInventory,craftItems:state.craftItems,favorites:getFavs()};
const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:"application/json"});
const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
const a=document.createElement("a");a.href=url;a.download="yw-craft-data.json";a.click();
URL.revokeObjectURL(url);showToast("Данные экспортированы!");
}

}

const _origOpenModal=openModal;
openModal=function(name){

// Add multi-craft section
const mcDiv=document.createElement("div");
mcDiv.innerHTML='<div class="section-title" style="margin-top:12px">Сколько нужно для N штук <span class="line"></span></div><div class="multi-craft-row"><label>Хочу:</label><input type="number" id="mcCount" min="1" value="1" max="999"><label>шт.</label><button class="mc-btn" id="mcCalcBtn">Рассчитать</button></div><div id="mcResult"></div>';
modalBody.appendChild(mcDiv);

document.getElementById("mcCalcBtn").addEventListener("click",function(){
const count=parseInt(document.getElementById("mcCount").value)||1;

document.addEventListener("click",function(e){

function timeAgo(ts){
const diff=Date.now()-ts;
const min=Math.floor(diff/60000);
if(min<1)return'только что';
if(min<60)return min+' мин. назад';
const hrs=Math.floor(min/60);
if(hrs<24)return hrs+' ч. назад';
const days=Math.floor(hrs/24);
return days+' дн. назад';
}

function undoCraft(idx){
const entry=state.craftHistory[idx];if(!entry)return;
entry.resources.forEach(res=>{
const invItem=state.inventory.find(x=>x.name===res.name);
if(invItem){invItem.qty+=res.qty}
else{state.inventory.push({name:res.name,qty:res.qty})}
});
state.craftHistory.splice(idx,1);
saveState();render();
showToast('Ресурсы возвращены!');
}

}

el.innerHTML=items;
}

});
